name: SUNSURIA
recent: Sunsuria 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日宣布，其 99.99% 子公司 Sunsuria City 与 Amazon Data Services Malaysia 签署有条件买卖协议，以约 RM316.84 million 现金出售雪兰莪 Dengkil 一块商业土地。同期，执行主席 Tan Sri Datuk Ter Leong Yap 及集团首席财务官 Yeap Yen Yen 在公开市场多次增持公司股份。公司 2026 财年第三季度净利同比增长超过一倍。
notable: Sunsuria City 与 Amazon Data Services Malaysia 签署有条件买卖协议，以约 RM316.84 million 出售雪兰莪 Dengkil 一块商业土地。
执行主席 Tan Sri Datuk Ter Leong Yap 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日至 10 月 14 日期间在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
集团首席财务官 Yeap Yen Yen 于 2026 年 10 月 8 日在公开市场增持 50,000 股公司股份。

news.title: Sunsuria to divest land for RM316.84mil
Amazon buys 2 million sq ft land in Selangor, Malaysia to build data center
Sunsuria proposes RM316.84m Sepang land sale to Amazon Data Services Malaysia
Sunsuria Unit To Sell Dengkil Land for RM316.84 Mln
Sunsuria 3Q26 net profit more than doubles to RM19mil
Sunsuria 3Q net profit more than doubles to RM19m, aided by KLCG gains

recent_en: On 28 September 2026, Sunsuria announced that its 99.99%-owned subsidiary Sunsuria City signed a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Amazon Data Services Malaysia to dispose of a parcel of commercial land in Dengkil, Selangor, for approximately RM316.84 million in cash. Meanwhile, Executive Chairman Tan Sri Datuk Ter Leong Yap and Group Chief Financial Officer Yeap Yen Yen acquired shares in the open market on several occasions. The company's 3Q26 net profit more than doubled year-on-year.
notable_en: Sunsuria City signed a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Amazon Data Services Malaysia to dispose of a parcel of commercial land in Dengkil, Selangor, for approximately RM316.84 million.
Executive Chairman Tan Sri Datuk Ter Leong Yap acquired shares in the open market on several occasions between 30 September and 14 October 2026.
Group Chief Financial Officer Yeap Yen Yen acquired 50,000 shares in the open market on 8 October 2026.
